library(shiny) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(stringr) library(ggplot2) library(leaflet) library(leaflet.extras) library(DT) library(scales) library(sf) library(S7) all <- readRDS("butt_points.rds") # source, name, lon, lat, populated, term, match, n_terms, terms_all, place_id, county_fips cty <- readRDS("counties.rds") # sf: GEOID, county, state, pop, total_Census, total_GNIS, total_OSM missing_cols <- setdiff(c("place_id", "county_fips", "populated", "n_terms", "terms_all"), names(all)) if (length(missing_cols)) stop("butt_points.rds is missing: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), ". Re-run the prep scripts.") missing_cty <- setdiff(c("pop", "total_Census", "total_GNIS", "total_OSM"), names(cty)) if (length(missing_cty)) stop("counties.rds is missing: ", paste(missing_cty, collapse = ", "), ". Re-run the county prep script.") # one row per place within each gazetteer, done once at load all <- all %>% distinct(source, place_id, .keep_all = TRUE) sources <- c("Census", "GNIS", "OSM") nsfw_terms <- c("ass") # add more here, e.g. c("ass", "jackass") all_terms <- sort(unique(all$term)) sfw_terms <- setdiff(all_terms, nsfw_terms) src_pal <- c(Census = "#1b6ca8", GNIS = "#3a9d5d", OSM = "#c2410c") # precomputed once so the cards, Terms chart and Names table do not scan the full data totals <- all %>% count(source) agg <- all %>% count(source, term, populated) names_agg <- all %>% count(name, terms_all, n_terms, term, populated, source) %>% mutate(Place = str_to_title(str_to_lower(name))) %>% select(-name) summ <- all %>% group_by(Gazetteer = source) %>% summarise(Places = n(), `Populated places` = sum(populated), `Unique names` = n_distinct(name)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), comma)) source_card <- function(s) { card( class = "kpi", style = paste0("border-top: 4px solid ", src_pal[[s]], ";"), card_header(checkboxInput(paste0("use_", s), strong(s), value = TRUE)), uiOutput(paste0("kpi_", s)) ) } ui <- page_sidebar( title = "Buttmap: place names by gazetteer", sidebar = sidebar( width = 280, selectizeInput("terms", "Terms", choices = sfw_terms, selected = sfw_terms, multiple = TRUE, options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))), input_switch("populated", "Populated places only (like Census)", value = FALSE), input_switch("nsfw", "Include NSFW terms", value = FALSE), hr(), p(class = "text-muted small", "Tick or untick a gazetteer card to include or exclude it."), downloadButton("dl", "Download filtered CSV") ), tags$style(".kpi .form-group { margin-bottom: 0; }"), layout_columns(fill = FALSE, col_widths = c(4, 4, 4), source_card("Census"), source_card("GNIS"), source_card("OSM")), navset_card_tab( nav_panel("Map", checkboxGroupInput("layers", NULL, c("Heatmap" = "heat", "Points" = "pts"), selected = "heat", inline = TRUE), leafletOutput("map", height = 600)), nav_panel("Counties", selectInput("metric", "Scale by", c("Per 1,000 place names" = "names", "Per 100,000 residents" = "pop", "Raw count" = "count")), layout_columns(col_widths = c(7, 5), leafletOutput("cmap", height = 560), plotOutput("ctop", height = 560))), nav_panel("Names", p(class = "text-muted", "Every matching place name, ranked by how many butt words it contains, then by how many places share it.", "Search above the table or in any column. Counts are places in each gazetteer."), DTOutput("names_tbl")), nav_panel("Terms", plotOutput("bars", height = 700)), nav_panel("About", div(style = "max-width: 56rem;", h4("What this is"), p("Place names that contain a butt-related term, compared across three US gazetteers.", "A gazetteer is a directory of place names with coordinates. Each point on the map is one named place", "whose name matched a list of about 20 terms."), h4("Data sources"), tags$table(class = "table table-sm align-middle", tags$thead(tags$tr( tags$th("Source"), tags$th("Who makes it"), tags$th("What is in it"), tags$th("Things to know"))), tags$tbody( tags$tr( tags$td(strong("Census")), tags$td("US Census Bureau, via the ", tags$code("tigris"), " R package"), tags$td("Incorporated places (cities, towns, villages) and Census Designated Places, from the 2020", " cartographic boundary files. Each place is placed at a point guaranteed to fall inside its boundary."), tags$td("Smallest of the three, and the most formal. These are populated places, so you will not find", " creeks, hills or lakes here.")), tags$tr( tags$td(strong("GNIS")), tags$td("US Geological Survey, for the US Board on Geographic Names"), tags$td("The Domestic Names file: the official federal record of names for both cultural features", " (towns, schools, churches, parks) and physical ones (summits, streams, valleys, lakes)."), tags$td("By far the largest source, with over two million features. It includes historical names and", " features that no longer exist. Public domain. ", tags$a(href = "https://www.usgs.gov/tools/geographic-names-information-system-gnis", target = "_blank", "USGS GNIS"))), tags$tr( tags$td(strong("OSM")), tags$td("OpenStreetMap contributors, packaged by ", tags$a(href = "https://osmnames.org/", target = "_blank", "OSMNames")), tags$td("Names from the OpenStreetMap planet file, US rows only. Roads, buildings and shops are removed;", " only place, natural, waterway and boundary features are kept."), tags$td("Crowdsourced, so it holds local and informal names the official sources lack, and the same", " real place is often listed more than once. Licensed under the ODbL.")) ) ), h4("Supporting data for the Counties tab"), tags$ul( tags$li(strong("County boundaries"), ": 2020 cartographic boundaries from the Census Bureau (", tags$code("tigris"), "). Each point is assigned to the county that contains it."), tags$li(strong("Population"), ": 2020 decennial census total population (table P1_001N, ", tags$code("tidycensus"), ")."), tags$li(strong("Place name totals"), ": for each county, the total number of names of any kind in each", " gazetteer. This is the denominator for the \"per 1,000 place names\" measure, so a county is not", " ranked high just because it has lots of named features.") ), h4("How it works"), tags$ul( tags$li("The three cards at the top are also the gazetteer checkboxes. Each shows the places displayed", " after your filters, out of the total matching places in that gazetteer."), tags$li("The Terms box starts with every term selected. Remove a term to drop it everywhere."), tags$li(strong("Populated places only"), " keeps the Census places, GNIS populated places and Census", " designated places, and OSM cities, towns, villages and hamlets. This makes GNIS and OSM", " comparable to Census by dropping creeks, summits and other natural features."), tags$li("Terms and the Terms chart count each name once, under the first butt word found in it.", " The Names tab shows every butt word in a name and ranks names by how many they contain."), tags$li("Repeats: the same real place can appear several times in one gazetteer, especially OSM.", " Rows with the same name within about 5 km are counted once. The map shows one point per place,", " merging the same place across the checked gazetteers."), tags$li("Counties: the Counties tab colors each county by matching places per 1,000 place names in that", " county, per 100,000 residents, or as a raw count. Counties with very few names or people can swing widely.") ), h4("Summary (all terms, before filters)"), tableOutput("summary"), p(class = "text-muted", "The NSFW switch controls the terms listed in ", tags$code("nsfw_terms"), ".") )) ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { # ---- sources chosen on the cards ---- sel_sources <- reactive( sources[vapply(sources, function(s) isTRUE(input[[paste0("use_", s)]]), logical(1))] ) # ---- NSFW toggle adds or removes those terms from the Terms box ---- observeEvent(input$nsfw, { on <- isTRUE(input$nsfw) ch <- if (on) all_terms else sfw_terms updateSelectizeInput(session, "terms", choices = ch, selected = if (on) union(input$terms, nsfw_terms) else intersect(input$terms, ch)) }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # ---- filtered data ---- d <- reactive({ x <- all %>% filter(source %in% sel_sources(), term %in% input$terms) if (isTRUE(input$populated)) x <- x %>% filter(populated) x }) # small precomputed counts for the cards and the Terms chart agg_f <- reactive({ x <- agg %>% filter(term %in% input$terms) if (isTRUE(input$populated)) x <- x %>% filter(populated) x }) no_rows <- "Nothing matches the current filters. Check that a gazetteer card and at least one term are selected." # ---- source cards ---- kpi_text <- function(s) { pop <- isTRUE(input$populated) switch(s, Census = "US Census Bureau incorporated places and Census Designated Places (2020). Always populated places.", GNIS = if (pop) "USGS federal names, limited to populated places and Census designated places." else "USGS federal names for towns, schools, creeks, summits, lakes and more, including historical features.", OSM = if (pop) "Crowdsourced OpenStreetMap names, limited to cities, towns, villages and hamlets." else "Crowdsourced OpenStreetMap names: places, natural features, waterways and boundaries (no roads)." ) } for (s in sources) local({ s <- s output[[paste0("kpi_", s)]] <- renderUI({ a <- agg_f() shown <- sum(a$n[a$source == s]) tot <- totals$n[totals$source == s] div( span(style = "font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 600;", comma(shown)), span(class = "text-muted", " of ", comma(tot), " places"), p(class = "text-muted small mt-2 mb-0", kpi_text(s)) ) }) }) output$summary <- renderTable(summ) # ---- names tab ---- names_data <- reactive({ x <- names_agg %>% filter(term %in% input$terms, source %in% sel_sources()) if (isTRUE(input$populated)) x <- x %>% filter(populated) if (nrow(x) == 0) { return(tibble(Place = character(), Words = integer(), `Which words` = character(), Total = integer())) } x %>% group_by(Place, Words = n_terms, `Which words` = terms_all, source) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% mutate(Total = rowSums(across(any_of(sources)))) %>% relocate(Place, Words, `Which words`) }) output$names_tbl <- renderDT({ tbl <- names_data() datatable(tbl, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 25, order = list(list(match("Words", names(tbl)) - 1, "desc"), list(match("Total", names(tbl)) - 1, "desc")))) }) outputOptions(output, "names_tbl", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE) # ---- terms tab ---- output$bars <- renderPlot({ cnt <- agg_f() %>% filter(source %in% sel_sources()) %>% group_by(term, source) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") validate(need(nrow(cnt) > 0, no_rows)) lv <- cnt %>% group_by(term) %>% summarise(n = sum(n)) %>% arrange(n) cnt %>% mutate(term = factor(term, levels = lv$term)) %>% ggplot(aes(n, term, fill = source)) + geom_col() + geom_text(data = lv %>% mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term)), aes(n, term, label = comma(n)), hjust = -0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) + scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) + scale_fill_manual(values = src_pal) + labs(x = "Matching places", y = NULL, fill = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) }) # ---- point map ---- map_ready <- reactiveVal(FALSE) observeEvent(input$map_bounds, map_ready(TRUE), once = TRUE) output$map <- renderLeaflet({ leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>% setView(lng = -96, lat = 38, zoom = 4) }) map_data <- reactive({ d() %>% group_by(place_id) %>% mutate(sources = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = " + ")) %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(place_id, .keep_all = TRUE) }) observe({ req(map_ready()) proxy <- leafletProxy("map") %>% clearMarkers() %>% clearHeatmap() dd <- map_data() if (nrow(dd) == 0) return() if ("heat" %in% input$layers) { proxy <- proxy %>% addHeatmap(lng = dd$lon, lat = dd$lat, max = 0.05, radius = 15, blur = 20, minOpacity = 0.05) } if ("pts" %in% input$layers) { proxy %>% addCircleMarkers(lng = dd$lon, lat = dd$lat, label = paste0(dd$name, " (", dd$sources, ")"), radius = 2, stroke = FALSE, fillColor = "#444444", fillOpacity = 1) } }) # ---- counties ---- unit <- reactive(c(names = "Per 1,000 place names", pop = "Per 100,000 residents", count = "Matching places")[[input$metric]]) county_data <- reactive({ req(length(sel_sources()) > 0) cnt <- d() %>% filter(!is.na(county_fips)) %>% group_by(GEOID = county_fips) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(place_id), .groups = "drop") x <- cty %>% left_join(cnt, by = "GEOID") %>% mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L)) x$names_total <- rowSums(st_drop_geometry(x)[, paste0("total_", sel_sources()), drop = FALSE]) x <- x %>% filter(pop > 0, names_total > 0) x$value <- switch(input$metric, names = x$n / (x$names_total / 1e3), pop = x$n / (x$pop / 1e5), count = x$n) x$cname <- paste0(x$county, ", ", x$state) x }) cmap_ready <- reactiveVal(FALSE) observeEvent(input$cmap_bounds, cmap_ready(TRUE), once = TRUE) output$cmap <- renderLeaflet({ leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>% setView(lng = -96, lat = 38, zoom = 4) }) observe({ req(cmap_ready()) x <- county_data() proxy <- leafletProxy("cmap") %>% clearShapes() %>% clearControls() if (nrow(x) == 0) return() br <- unique(quantile(x$value, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 8), na.rm = TRUE)) if (length(br) < 3) br <- pretty(range(x$value), 5) cpal <- colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = x$value, bins = br) proxy %>% addPolygons(data = x, fillColor = ~cpal(value), fillOpacity = 0.85, color = "white", weight = 0.3, label = ~lapply(sprintf("%s
%s matching places
%s", cname, n, number(value, accuracy = 0.01)), htmltools::HTML)) %>% addLegend(pal = cpal, values = x$value, title = unit(), position = "bottomright") }) output$ctop <- renderPlot({ x <- county_data() %>% st_drop_geometry() validate(need(nrow(x) > 0, no_rows)) x %>% slice_max(value, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ggplot(aes(value, reorder(cname, value))) + geom_col(fill = "#c2410c") + geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = 1.2, colour = "white", size = 3.5) + labs(x = unit(), y = NULL, title = "Buttiest counties", subtitle = "Numbers inside bars are matching places") + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) }) # ---- download ---- output$dl <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "buttmap_filtered.csv", content = function(file) write.csv(d(), file, row.names = FALSE) ) } shinyApp(ui, server)
